questions.question: What makes Claude pick your skill when you type 'can you do the weekly?'
questions.explanation: The description is the trigger. It must contain the phrases you actually use.

questions.question: The `name:` field must be...
questions.explanation: name = folder name, or the skill does not load as /name.

questions.question: Your SKILL.md is 400 lines. Best move?
options: Move templates and examples to references/ and point to them
Split into two skills with the same name
questions.explanation: Progressive disclosure: short procedure, long references loaded only when the skill runs.

questions.question: The weekly report came out wrong. Where do you fix it?
options: In the skill, then run it again
questions.explanation: Fix the procedure once and every future run is right. Fixing the output fixes one Monday.
